# Swadam Foods

> Authentic Indian snacks and instant premixes, made with real ingredients and traditional recipes. A women-owned and women-operated food business based in Pune, India.

## Products

- **Patal Poha Chivda** (200 g, ₹90) — Signature crunchy flattened rice snack with roasted peanuts, curry leaves and turmeric-spice blend. Ready to eat. Bestseller.
- **Instant Kanda Poha Premix** (150 g, ₹70) — Just add hot water, rest 5 minutes. Authentic Maharashtra-style Kanda Poha with onions, chilies and turmeric.
- **Instant Upma Premix** (150 g, ₹70) — Just add hot water, rest 5 minutes. Savoury semolina upma with curry leaves, mustard and chilies.
